description: This file defines an abstract class 'TestCaseAbstract' in the SuiteCRM namespace, which extends PHPUnit's TestCase. It includes setup and teardown methods managing database transactions or refresh strategies and contains licensing and package-level documentation.

classes.name: SuiteCRM\TestCaseAbstract
classes.description: An abstract base class for test cases with database transaction and refresh management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment, starts database transaction or refreshes database depending on configuration.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Cleans up after test execution, rolling back transactions if enabled.
